artifacts.notes: Uncorrected optical text of the whole digitisation: a Mohawk Book of Common Prayer with English section headings, ending in the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek's own catalogue block, which is where the identification above was read. 3735 LF-terminated lines. Extent as measured by the retrieving lane: Optical-text layer of the Bavarian State Library's 1867 Book of Common Prayer item, 96 KB and far too short to be the whole book; searched for the collect with no hit and set aside as an inadequate digitisation.
